name: ARK-4
description: Next Generation Custom Firmware for the PSP and Vita's ePSP.
long_description: New, updated, improved and modern `Custom Firmware` for the `PSP` and `PS Vita`'s `ePSP`. Simple to use and full of unique features, `ARK CFW` aims at keeping the `PSP` experience fresh. Being a successor to `PRO` and `ME`, `ARK` is now the most feature-complete `CFW` for the `PSP`, having all features from classic `CFW` as well as unique and exclusive new features not found anywhere else.
